items.name: Agent-Kernel
items.description: A MicroKernel Multi-Agents System Framework for Adaptive Social Simulation Powered by LLMs

items.name: worldcup-sim
items.description: Explore and simulate the 2026 FIFA World Cup — typed tournament data, an LLM simulation kernel, and in-browser TTS commentary.

items.name: esp32-p4-llm-cluster-research
items.description: Reproducible two-board ESP32-P4 LLM experiments: Ethernet transport, parallel dispatch, dual-core kernels, memory optimization, simulation and text-quality evaluation.

items.name: agent-skills-for-compute
items.description: Agent-optimized skills for the full LLM lifecycle — pre-training, post-training (RL/DPO/RLHF), inference, and autonomous research — plus GPU/TPU/QPU kernel programming, simulation, and scientific computing

items.name: Babel
items.description: AI World State Machine — define a world seed, watch autonomous agents interact, form alliances, betray, and generate emergent narratives. Modality-agnostic. Pluggable brains via World Kernel Protocol. 188 tests.

items.name: simulacra
items.description: Typed, event-sourced kernel for LLM-driven social simulation with a built-in robustness-audit harness. CLI, HTTP API, MCP server, GUI.

items.name: silicon-to-token
items.description: CUDA kernels, a minimal LLM inference engine, and accelerator simulation, with reproducible benchmarks.

items.name: mnehmos-engine
items.description: A generative simulation kernel for living worlds. LLM-driven agents with persistent memory, validated by a deterministic engine, in a multi-region world with a labor-based economy.

items.name: sales-simulation
items.description: MinervAI Sales Simulation Framework is an application of object oriented LLMs incorporated using Microsoft semantic kernels to suit the specific application of empowering sales teams to improve upon their practices so that they can reach further goals.

items.name: MultiAgentAiSimulation-SK
items.description: Simulates a pizza restaurant using AI agents built with Semantic Kernel and Azure OpenAI. Includes an order taker that confirms and summarizes orders, and a kitchen manager that breaks them into cooking steps. Demonstrates multi-agent prompt orchestration and LLM-based workflow automation in Python.
